notes.title: V0.88a Caramela and Cosmetic Variants!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Everyone! Tinfoil here again.[/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces one of our newest characters Caramela! Seemingly a Foodcorp Executive and manager. Enjoy her new perks, achievements, and dialogue in game[/p][p][/p][p]We also have gotten feedback on the game with the desire for some sort of endgame progression. While we will eventually add challenge and perfection achievements in the game for that purpose, another thing that was requested is some sort of money sink. This update introduces cosmetic variants to the game! These are variants of cosmetics that will cost a certain (usually high) amount of money to purchase. There are only two variants currently but we will add a lot more soon![/p][p][/p][p]New Achievements[/p][list][*][p]Fast Food[/p][/*][*][p]From Beyond[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]New Cosmetics[/p][list][*][p]Hunting Cap[/p][/*][*][p]Leather Cape[/p][/*][*][p]Spiral Glasses (Variant)[/p][/*][*][p]Galaxy Chef Beyond (Variant)[/p][/*][/list][p]Endless Augments[/p][list][*][p]Accidents Happen[/p][/*][*][p]Work Injury[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Hazard[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Qol/Bug Fix Updates:[/p][list][*][p]Character limit for lobby names[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the desert food fight map for hidden cosmetic issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to pick up items player is knocked out[/p][/*][*][p]Work Injury and Accidents Happen Endless perks (Negative Perks!)[/p][/*][*][p]Score Adjustments and trio adjustments for levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Result Menu not updating correctly sometimes at end of level[/p][/*][*][p]Cookbots will cancels task when transitioning to next days in endless[/p][/*][*][p]UI Order Scaling in Options Menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: QoL & Trios Support v0.87a
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, Tinfoil here.[/p][p]I have heard feedback that trios is too difficult. Especially when the game is only configured for 1,2, or 4 players. Here is a update to help with that.[/p][p]- \[Trio] Map Logics are different now. Trios will still play with 4-player orders and scoring, but some maps may be different for 3 players vs 4. If there is still issues, please report to the discord and I can rebalance the difficulty [/p][p][/p][p][b]QoL[/b][/p][p]- Increased Food Icon UI size by ~25%[/p][p]- Water Pots will swap out with other water pots or food pieces for clients.[/p][p]- Food Disconnection Logic Reworked. This is to allow for more types of disconnections[/p][p]- You can now disconnect onions/herbs from soups, sushi, meat buns before cooking, etc[/p][p]- Improved Coloring visibility of Sparkling and Ice on drinks[/p][p]- Hue of tomato and carrot soups adjusted for clearer look[/p][p]- Fixed perks retaining effects from level to level[/p][p]- Fixed throwing side orders not working[/p][p][/p][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][p]- Hurry Curry Rework (50% eat speed when nearby -> 25% eat speed always)[/p][p]- Zesty Step Buff (10% speed increase -> 15% percent)[/p][p]- Cookbot Perk Buff (5% speed increase -> 10% percent)[/p][p]- Quik Wash Buff (25% faster sink wash -> 35% faster sink wash)[/p][p]- Cookie Perk Buff (2 seconds -> 3 seconds)[/p][p]- Good Service Nerf (5 seconds -> 4 seconds)[/p][p]- Cheffery Perk Buff (25% cutting speed -> 30% cutting speed)[/p]

notes.title: Perks Update! v0.85
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, Tinfoil here![/p][p][/p][p]Its been a bit more than a week since the early access release and I'm happy to have gotten alot of feedback over these days. This update will be adding the Perk System to the game in preparation for all the future progression system the game will have. The next couple of updates will focus on fixing more issues that might come from this. But other than that, listening to the players and making updates as they feel the game needs![/p][p][/p][p]- Perks![/p][p]	- Characters have their own minor perk[/p][p]	- Major perks can be unlocked in the perk tab in the character page. 2 can be equipped at a time[/p][p]- New Achievements:[/p][p]	- Getting Started[/p][p]	- Refused Service[/p][p]	- Wet Boy[/p][p]	- Careful![/p][p]- Two New Cosmetics[/p][p]	- Big Sword[/p][p]	- The Guzzler[/p][p]- Fixed Yummy! Achievement not being able to trigger[/p][p]- Expert Achievement Scoring adjustments[/p][p]- Fixed Steam Achievement not always triggering alongside the in-game achievements[/p][p]- Cut chicken and diced fish locked until 3-3. When they are needed[/p][p]- Removed Super hearing endless perk (Now a player perk)[/p][p]- Jealous Customers Nerf. 5 second debuff -> 10 seconds[/p][p]- New Endless perk: Hammer (Move any gameplay station)[/p][p]- Popular Business nerf: Increased value 2 -> 1 [/p][p]- Increased Endless difficulty base across all maps[/p][p]- Grandmaster Cook is needed for galaxy chef hat now instead of Star Chef[/p][p]- Endless perks properly work for choice limits[/p][p]- Fixed bug where placing a food piece into a pot while on a crane would cause infinite food[/p][p]- Fixed bug where starting another day with a pot on the stove would take the pot off of the stove[/p][p]- Throwing a dirty dish near the sink will trigger it's auto-catch, instead of needing to start further away[/p][p]- Fixed polaroid not working for clients[/p][p]- Fixed jumping from aircannon, geyser stopping your momentum[/p][p]- Max frame rate is now capped to your monitor, instead of a hard cap of 240[/p]

notes.title: QoL Updates v0.81b
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Here's a patch notes for the current fixes. Thank you for the players who gave feedback and reports!

- Side Orders will now detect better when thrown at a table
- Polaroid Item added to game
- Reduced stars needed for special levels (5 stars less)
- Improved Portal teleport consistency, now client-based teleporting.
- Endless Perks now sometimes incorporate requirements to show up
- [Shady Dealings] endless perk
- Fixed baked fish not allowing rice to be placed in it
- Some endless perks will come with multi choices. I.E. ingredient box will now give you three options
- You can now vote for rerolls and skips as non-host in endless
- Noodles in a pot now show up as burnt when they burn
- You can take out charcoal from a burnt pot instead of having to dump it in trash
- You can now throw valid foods into a pot when it is on a stove to add to it
- Portable camera on all maps + you can interact with it before the store opens
- Burnt pots no longer give you an non-burnt food when pulling it out
- Fixed how some levels don't match up with the expert thresholds
- Fixed Star Chef Achievement

notes.title: Foodslingers Early Access Release!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Kenny here, aka Tinfoil[/p][p][/p][p]We are all excited to release this game to everyone and we hope that you all enjoy it as much as we do.[/p][p][/p][p]I, with the help of my friends have been developing this game on our free time over the past year. We made this in the goal of building a experience that creates memories between friends by challenging them in a way that requires strong teamwork. I really do mean it when I say that feedback and suggestions will affect the game as we just want to build a fun experience for players.[/p][p][/p][p]If you guys have suggestions, feedback, or bug reports. I strongly encourage you join the Discord at[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/WvQKEUu2Bg"]https://discord.gg/WvQKEUu2Bg[/url] to let us know! Otherwise, let it be known in the Steam Forums[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the discord, we intend to set up events or polls. To help decide what cosmetics, achievements, and features you guys want in the game[/p][p][/p][p]Issues with the game is mostly multiplayer focused. There are edge case issues that may occur when doing actions at the same time for players or things not syncing up. If any large glitches or bugs occurs. Having everyone quickly restart the game will likely resolve the issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Future Plans:[/p][p]We plan to begin developing the 4th map, more characters, special mode updates, and endless mode changes (Be sure to give feedback on this one!).[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Tinfoil[/p]
